title: Payload — entity.updated
$comment: The deliberate exception to total replacement: resolved PER FIELD, so an omitted field means 'said nothing about', not 'clear it'. additionalProperties is true by design: the versioning rules require that a new optional field survives a node that cannot interpret it, preserved byte-exactly for the digest. Every envelope field name is forbidden here (set to false): the convention that a payload never duplicates the envelope is enforced by the schema, not left to prose.

then.$comment: A derived identifier without its descriptor is indistinguishable from a random one.

else.$comment: A descriptor only means anything for entity: identifiers.
